posts.name: Christine Creed
posts.cooked:
Arthur Aihaken:

I think we’re a long way before even thinking about integrating AI into EVE.

I wouldnt bet any isk on that. AI is moving at a very accelerated rate through our little world and pretty much everything has it implemented in one form or another. Saving time is the biggest factor and its been a huge help to many people in the fields of it being the biggest advantage…gaming especially.

This may be a bad example, but for anyone here that played New World…you can thank AI for that being sunsetted in Jan27. It was lightning fast. One minute the game releases a new expansion and doing better than it ever had…then the next minute we are getting an announcement that its being shut down.

Thats off the subject of implementation…but just an example of how fast some things can progress.
